name: tools.magne/catalog
title: magne.tools
description: Hand-checked catalog of APIs, MCP servers and models for developers, searchable by task.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Keyword search over the published catalog, with the site's full-text filters (Turkish task phrases, country words such as "turkey", facets such as "free" or "open source"); every word is read as finished, never as a prefix: up to 12 tools in rank order, each once, with id, name, kind, tagline, pricing and tool page URL, and the catalog tasks a Turkish phrase in the query named (often none for English queries; use list_tasks for those). One job per call: search 'send email' and 'accept payments' separately. Results are not judged for fit, so check them with get_tool.

query.description: A few words naming the job, e.g. "send transactional email" or "accept payments in turkey".

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Every task in the catalog, grouped by area in catalog order: each task's name, slug, number of published tools and page URL.

tools.name: find_tools_for_task
tools.description: The published tools for one task, by name: id, name, kind, tagline, pricing and tool page URL. An unknown task returns an error naming the closest tasks.

task.description: A task name or slug from list_tasks, e.g. "send email" or "send-email".

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: One tool's card by id: tagline, use cases, pricing, auth, links and a code snippet, with its tool page URL and its tasks.

id.description: A tool id from find_tools_for_task, e.g. "resend".
